purpose: Third surface-authorship calibration pilot: eliminate document-length/training-word-mass asymmetry by using exactly four 50-word source prefixes per author in each matched-platform leave-one-source-group-out fold, and 50-word prefixes for every held-out document.

selection.joel: For each fold: Lucid Dreaming plus the three non-held-out matched Joel documents having at least 50 words. The 13-word Anatta fragment and 47-word Sound/Bahiya fragment are excluded from this equal-budget experiment.
selection.controls: Four largest non-overlap explicit-speaker Dharma documents per control, each required to contain at least 50 words.
selection.normalization: Preserve original canonical characters, punctuation and whitespace through the end of the 50th word token; discard the suffix. Do not reconstruct or re-tokenize prose.

interpretation.comparison_target: If character-based Joel attribution remains weak after exact 50-word equalization, document-length/training-word-mass imbalance is not sufficient to explain the surface instrument failure. If it materially improves, retain length normalization as a mandatory calibration control.
